description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

The Dexcom Developer API provides authorized third-party applications with read access to a Dexcom user's continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data. Resources include estimated glucose values (EGVs), calibrations, events, alerts, devices, and data range. The API uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow and exposes separate sandbox and production environments.
